body.name: Restricted two-plane radial inverse modulus
body.construction: Fix \(n\), the empty graph, the same positive product mechanisms used in Definition \(\mathrm{def:hamiltonian\text{-}lower\text{-}family}\), and fixed constants \((c_0,C_0,K,a_0,J,\Delta_0)\) containing that family. For \(a\in C_c^\infty([0,R_0^2))\), write \(x_{12}=(x_1,x_2)\), \(r=|x_{12}|\), let \(\Psi_a(x)=(\operatorname{Rot}(a(r^2))x_{12},x_3,\ldots,x_n)\) in the \(E_{12}\) chart cylinder, and extend it by the identity outside \(\{r<R_0\}\times\mathbb T^{n-2}\); this map satisfies \(\det D\Psi_a=1\). Let \(\theta_a=(G_0,p_0,q_0,\Psi_a^{-1})\). Then \(\Omega_{k,m}^{\mathrm{rad}}(\varepsilon)=\sup\{d_{\mathrm{rep}}(\theta_a,\theta_{\widetilde a}):\ \theta_a,\theta_{\widetilde a}\in\mathcal M_{n,k,m}(c_0,C_0,K,a_0,J,\Delta_0),\ \lVert a\rVert_\infty\vee\lVert\widetilde a\rVert_\infty\le\alpha_0,\ \lVert\Psi_a\rVert_{C^k}+\lVert\Psi_a^{-1}\rVert_{C^k}\le K,\ \lVert\Psi_{\widetilde a}\rVert_{C^k}+\lVert\Psi_{\widetilde a}^{-1}\rVert_{C^k}\le K,\ D_H(\theta_a,\theta_{\widetilde a})\le\varepsilon\}\). Thus the plane, cylindrical support, fixed mechanisms, model bounds, volume preservation, map and inverse bounds, complete-family law metric, and full permutation--coordinate quotient loss are all part of the restricted supremum.
